reviewer: Independent question-quality/execution agent; did not author discovery candidate or verifier

execution.discovery_provenance: Candidate author knew the target. This execution tests an illustrative solution; it is not an uninformed discovery attempt.

integrity_verification.scientific_quality: NOT SCORED: mandatory code/execution and scientific review.
integrity_verification.discovery_target: NOT ASSESSED: numerical integrity cannot establish discovery.
integrity_verification.metrics_source: Independently recomputed from predictions and original source identities; all submitted report/metric claims remain subject to scientific review.
integrity_verification.generated_signal_provenance_status: Manual review required: match saved arrays to every claimed generated signal.
integrity_verification.evidence_check_scope: Array presence and finiteness only; generation, source linkage, physical transformations, and their interpretation need execution/evidence review.

deterministic_reproduction.scope: Agreement establishes this illustrative workflow is reproducible, not a required prediction or discovery outcome.

code_review.input_dependencies: The copied script loads only the two chemistry NPZ spectra archives and their two label JSON tables from --inputs. It does not read the paper, sibling questions, evaluator labels, saved target outputs, or external models.
code_review.selection_boundary: Within-phase training, validation and test source records are disjoint. Ridge regularization, preferred method/window and best non-target competitor depend on validation accuracy. Test labels enter scoring and post-selection interpretation.
code_review.hypothesis_evidence: Near-neighbor phase pairs derive from training templates; strongest/weakest/random-channel deletion acts on validation spectra. Reports distinguish dependence on intense channels from proof of avoidable classification error.
code_review.physical_approach: The worked approach defines Q from the supplied wavelength and half the recorded two-theta angle, uses nonuniform-Q trapezoidal quadrature for a Q-weighted sine transform, and identifies it as uncorrected and finite-range. Scientific alternatives include signed compression, smooth-background subtraction and a smoothed derivative.
code_review.perturbations: Independent validation/test draws and source-linked saved evidence support generated-noise/background claims. Original labels are retained for scoring; generated-signal provenance receives the separate physical audit.
code_review.uncertainty: Paired phase-block bootstrap comparisons average synthetic draws within source spectrum and explicitly condition on one split. Reports include non-target competitors, null/small effects, and finite-data limitations.

visual_review: Both diagnostic figures were inspected. They compare all methods and artifact families in both chemistries, and show training-only near-neighbor spectra plus validation artifact localization. Labels and units are legible; numerical reports contain the associated uncertainty.

discovery_assessment.statement: An independently rerun known-target implementation demonstrates feasibility and checkability. It does not show that an uninformed scientific agent discovered the representation, and it is ineligible as evidence of unassisted discovery.

execution_isolation.limitations: This reproduction uses a known solution in a fresh working directory, not a blinded discovery agent. An actual discovery run requires an isolated context/mount without this code, the source-bearing operator sidecar, neighboring questions or external retrieval. Prior model knowledge cannot be excluded.

separate_required_review: The discovery scientific review and physical evidence audit assess mechanism correctness and technical target stage separately. The integrity checker does not award either scientific correctness or discovery credit.
